2610.13337.title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
2610.13337.paper_summary: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.
2610.13337.paper_summary_zh: 注意力匯聚點是持續獲得不成比例的注意力質量的標記或位置，通常超出其語義內容所暗示的範疇。儘管在大型語言模型中進行了廣泛的研究，但它們在文本到圖像（T2I）Transformer中的行為和功能相關性仍然大多未被探索。為了填補這一空白並更好地理解文本到圖像Transformer如何分配和引導注意力，我們探討了雙向擴散模型和因果自回歸模型中的文本到圖像Transformer現象。具體而言，我們探索注意力匯聚點是否存在、它們的出現位置以及它們如何在功能上影響生成。通過系統的注意力分析和針對性干預，我們發現注意力匯聚點在雙向擴散模型和自回歸模型中均出現，但展現出不同的模式。自回歸模型將注意力集中在第一個和全球範圍的標記上，而雙向模型則在模態邊界、文本區域和空間角落附近發展匯聚點。此外，這些模式在生成階段之間有所變化，並且局限於一小部分層和頭。為了評估它們的功能相關性，我們擾動與匯聚點相關的頭和標記位置。結果顯示，擾動匯聚點排名的頭產生的平均變化比非匯聚點比較更大，而某些匯聚點位置的擾動對雙向模型的得分影響有限。我們進一步引入註冊標記以重新分配注意力匯聚點，發現幾種配置能夠保持或適度改善生成性能。總的來說，注意力匯聚點是依賴於架構、推理階段和組件的現象，為文本到圖像Transformer中的機制分析和原則性注意力設計提供了基礎。
